notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 101–503, § 2, Nov. 3, 1990, 104 Stat. 1292, which set out congressional findings and purposes, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 101–503, § 1, Nov. 3, 1990, 104 Stat. 1292, provided that Pub. L. 101–503, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Seneca Nation Settlement Act of 1990”.

ancestors.heading: SENECA NATION (NEW YORK) LAND CLAIMS SETTLEMENT
